★ Request
Display Dearing Heart (Gym Uniform - Summer)

If we want to win... this is where the real work begins!
Are you ready?

Deep down, you probably prefer quiet places like this, don't you?
...Whenever you don't like something, it's totally okay to say no, you know?

Yeah.
...Hehe, do you look a little relieved, maybe?
...Really?

I love that world of yours.
I love hearing you talk about the world through your eyes.

That's right! Survival is all about how you manage your time!
Just like we planned last night, let's get moving briskly!

Still, one of the judging criteria is "Envy-Inducing Survival."
...Maybe being just "perfect" won't be enough to—

You've got to be kidding me!
You're easily one of the most exciting people I know!

We passed a river on the way here for water, so... food is next on the list.
Trainer, could you gather some branches and vines we could use for cord?

I'm stunned. I had no idea Dearing Heart
thought of me that way...

Let's see... The judging criteria are "Peace of Mind," "Safety," and
"Envy-Inducing Survival," according to this.

Glad to hear that!
Once we catch our breath, let's go check the traps in the river!

Food and shelter are both taken care of flawlessly.
There's not a single flaw to point out.

We could use flowers... or put small bonfires in empty cans to make lanterns.
Either way, I want it to be gorgeous and emotional!

Alright, let's do this!
Now that we've decided, there's no time to waste. Let's go gather materials!

When I hear survival, there's no way I'm just sitting on the sidelines!
Hey Trainer—give it a try with me!

Hey! Did you hear? They're holding a
"Deserted Island Survival Contest" on our day off during summer camp!

...I'm sorry, you know.
I feel like I'm always dragging you out to loud, crowded places.

Once that's done, we'll forage for ingredients in the hills
while doing a flotsam check!
Well? How does it feel to lie on?

The grand prize is—the "Perfect Survival Kit"!
Be sure to make great use of it during your training!
Heh! All that's left is to take our submission photo right here... and whoops!
—You've gotta be kidding me!

I'm back—Hey, what's up?
Why the furrowed brow?

Your world is always brimming with mysteries and wonder.
So many wonders and questions that never even cross my mind.

Well, we've arrived!
As much as I'd love to soak in this gorgeous view...

Nice idea! Hey, let's make another one, shall we?
It'd look so much better if we wore matching ones!
...You really are something else.

Oh, right! We have to wear these!
Same to you too!
That's my line, isn't it, my heart?

Hehe... Perfect, even if I do say so myself!
...Okay, I'm going to wash my hands.
And above all, when I'm with Dearing Heart—
...Hehe. Not really.

You get it? That boundless curiosity and spirit of inquiry of yours
has completely stolen my heart away!

Watching her walk off toward the spring,
I glance around our impeccably arranged base camp.

You really are the absolute best!
You're fire!

No, you're totally right. What they're looking for
isn't just "perfect," but "envy-inducing" survival!

I nod while looking out at the sea. ...I'm always stuck in my head, slow to take action.
Yet somehow, whenever I'm with her, that boring side of me—

Yes! We'll make simple traps and set them up beforehand.
Looks like we've got full permission sorted out, too.
...Wait, what are you doing?

Pfft, hahaha!
...Looks like our next day off might end up on a deserted island too, huh?
Do you understand?

What?
Boring... you?
A "Perfect Survival Kit"...

Yes, we decorate!
This entire base camp!

And the glorious winners of our Deserted Island Survival Contest are
...the Dearing Heart team! Congratulations!
And just like that, the Deserted Island Survival Contest came to a successful close...
(Thud, thud, thud!)
Wow.
Hey! You're gonna drop them!

Nice catch!
That's our vitamins and dessert officially gotten!

We're in luck! There's a cozy little cave right here.
Let's set up camp here this time!

With that, I share my earlier thought with her:
that maybe we need one more clever touch to secure victory...

After finishing our dinner,
we headed down to the shore together for a proper celebration.

Hehe, this island is packed with great flotsam.
...I'm done! There, the hammock's all finished! Go ahead, hop in.

Steeling my resolve, I lie back in the hammock
that Dearing Heart built from washed-up driftwood.

Fish, fruit...
Water boiling looks good, and...

And so, on our day off during summer camp,
Dearing Heart and I traveled together to a nearby deserted island.

Yes! Stylish and comfortable.
No matter who looks at it, this base camp screams "pure envy"!

Look... sea glass!
Let's gather a bunch and arrange them neatly on the table!
